name: TICO-19 Test — All Pairs
description: Multi-way parallel evaluation corpus from the Translation Initiative for COVID-19. 36 languages (including English source), 2100 test sentences each, all sentence-aligned via English pivot. Medical/crisis domain — the ONLY medical domain corpus in the project. CC0 licensed. Source data covers 37 target-language files but Tigrinya has three variants (ti, ti_ER, ti_ET) that all map to ISO 639-3 tir, yielding 35 unique target languages.

segments.name: Development
segments.purpose: Hyperparameter tuning, prompt development — medical/crisis domain

segments.name: Test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — medical/crisis domain test split

download.instructions: Download and unzip. TSV files at tico19-testset/test/test.en-{lang_code}.tsv and tico19-testset/dev/dev.en-{lang_code}.tsv. Format: sourceLang\ttargetLang\tsourceString\ttargetString\tstringID\turl\tlicense\ttranslator_id. English is the pivot; non-English pairs are aligned on the shared stringID. Tigrinya has three file variants: ti (original), ti_ER (Eritrean), ti_ET (Ethiopian).

source.publisher: TICO-19 Consortium (CMU, JHU, GMU, Amazon, Appen, Facebook, Google, Microsoft, Translated, TWB)
source.citation: Anastasopoulos et al. (2020). TICO-19: the Translation Initiative for COvid-19.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Although CC0-licensed, this corpus is reserved as an evaluation benchmark within Champollion. doNotTrain is set to protect benchmark integrity, not due to license restrictions.

contamination.reasoning: Specialized medical/crisis domain content created specifically for COVID-19 translation evaluation. Not a standard MT training corpus. Some sentences originate from CMU medical domain sentences and WHO/CDC public health materials. Less likely to appear in general-purpose LLM training than news-domain benchmarks like FLORES+ or NTREX.

_provenance.populatedFrom: TICO-19 testset zip (tico19-testset.zip), README.md within zip, ACL paper (2020.nlpcovid19-acl.1), TICO-19 website (tico-19.github.io). Sentence counts verified by direct line count of extracted TSV files.
